mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment ( appointment_id, appointment_date, appointment_time, patient_id, doctor_id, active ) VALUES ( #{appointmentId}, #{appointmentDate}, #{appointmentTime}, #{patient.patientId}, #{doctor.staffId}, #{active} )
mapper.select:
SELECT a.*, p.patient_name, p.age, p.gender, p.phone, d.staff_id, d.staff_name, d.specialization, d.consultation_fee
FROM appointment a
JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id
JOIN doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.staff_id
WHERE a.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND a.appointment_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND a.active = true
ORDER BY a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time

SELECT a.*,
p.patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age, p.gender, p.phone, p.active,
d.staff_id, d.staff_name, d.specialization, d.consultation_fee
FROM appointment a
JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id
JOIN doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.staff_id
WHERE a.appointment_id = #{appointmentId}

SELECT a.*,
p.patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age, p.gender, p.phone, p.active,
d.staff_id, d.staff_name, d.specialization, d.consultation_fee
FROM appointment a
JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id
JOIN doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.staff_id
WHERE a.active = TRUE

SELECT a.*,
p.patient_id, p.patient_name, p.age, p.gender, p.phone, p.active,
d.staff_id, d.staff_name, d.specialization, d.consultation_fee
FROM appointment a
JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id
JOIN doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.staff_id
WHERE a.patient_id = #{patientId} AND a.active = TRUE
ORDER BY a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time
